name: person_knows
query: UNWIND $s AS x MATCH (a:Person {uuid: x})-[:KNOWS*1..2]-(b:Person) RETURN b.uuid AS u LIMIT $limit

name: person_creator
query: UNWIND $s AS x MATCH (m:Message {uuid: x})-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person) RETURN p.uuid AS u LIMIT $limit

name: message_creator
query: UNWIND $s AS x MATCH (p:Person {uuid: x})<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(m:Message) RETURN m.uuid AS u LIMIT $limit

name: message_knows
query: UNWIND $s AS x MATCH (a:Person {uuid: x})-[:KNOWS*1..2]-(b:Person)<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(m:Message) RETURN m.uuid AS u LIMIT $limit

name: message_tag
query: UNWIND $s AS x MATCH (t:Tag {uuid: x})<-[:HAS_TAG]-(m:Message) RETURN m.uuid AS u LIMIT $limit

name: start_person_key
query: MATCH (n:Person) WHERE n.id IN $s RETURN n.uuid AS u

name: start_message_key
query: MATCH (n:Message) WHERE n.id IN $s RETURN n.uuid AS u

name: start_person_date
query: MATCH (n:Person) RETURN n.uuid AS u, n.creationDate.epochMillis AS k

name: start_message_date
query: MATCH (n:Message) RETURN n.uuid AS u, n.creationDate.epochMillis AS k
